failure_modes: Transfer of the wrong knowledge is not detected before the predecessor ends
Losing valuable knowledge that a successor would need
gloss: Pass useful knowledge to a successor and let the predecessor end
invariants: Each instance has a bounded lifetime
mechanism: An endlessly learning agent accumulates junk. Ending an instance and passing selected knowledge to a successor applies {{forgetting}} at the lifetime scale: those that transfer wrong knowledge fail to continue. The knowledge sits in the {{innate}} layer that outlives each instance, and the known end gives the instance the effort effect described in {{horizon}}.
